name: 13 柱庭 / Cabal 13
description:
About This Game

Welcome to The 《Cabal 13》, a multiplayer roguelike auto-battler game centered on RPG hero development! Here, every match is a brand-new adventure, and every choice determines victory or defeat. Select your champion from a roster of legendary heroes with distinct playstyles, build a one-of-a-kind team, and clash with other players on a dynamically evolving battlefield to experience the in-depth fun of hero-focused roguelike auto-battling.

Heroes Reign Supreme, Forge Your Legend

Choose your destined avatar from over 20 mighty legendary heroes. Each hero is more than just a unit—they are a complete core gameplay experience and a saga of growth. Unique skill trees, exclusive synergy combinations, and innate talents will fully define your strategic blueprint. Will you summon an undead horde, unleash a zerg swarm, or build an unstoppable mechanical army? Your hero is the starting point of a legend.

Rich Content, Endless Combinations

The game features over 300 distinct units, interacting with more than 60 stackable talents and 40+ random events that can turn the tide of battle in an instant. Combined with the unique abilities of over 20 core heroes, these elements create near-infinite tactical combinations. In every match, you can explore a brand-new path to victory.

Unique Mechanics, Stack & Grow

With innovative stacking and mounting mechanics, experience the ultimate thrill of explosive stats and merged effects.

In-Depth Roguelike, Replayability Guaranteed

No two matches are ever the same. Every game presents you with different random events, units, and talents. Combine seemingly ordinary units with hero abilities and random buffs to create a dream combo that overwhelms your opponents. Every restart is a perfect chance to discover new tactics.

Asynchronous Battles, Master the Art of Strategy

Featuring a meticulously designed asynchronous battle system, we bring you a pure and in-depth strategic competitive experience. Say goodbye to the anxiety of fast reflexes and real-time pressure—here, only true wisdom and team-building artistry matter. You have ample time to think carefully, calculate precisely, and simulate your lineup. Refine every step, from unit trades and talent selections to formation adjustments. In a fair thinking environment, polish your perfect team and launch a steady assault on The Thirteen Pillars Court.
short_desc: Welcome to《Cabal 13》— an asynchronous roguelike auto-battler built around hero RPG progression! Every run is a fresh adventure, every choice shapes victory or defeat. Assemble your unique squad, clash with rivals on dynamic battlefields, and dive into deep, hero-focused roguelike auto-battler fun.
